index.name: EGM2008 geoid, 2.5′
index.description: The EGM2008 geoid at its published 2.5′ grid instead of the base pack's 5′: heights above sea level within a few centimetres of the full model in high mountains, where the base pack's grid can be half a metre off. Replaces the base pack's EGM2008 grid while installed.

sources.name: EGM2008 geoid undulations, 2.5′ grid (NGA, as distributed by PROJ)
